name: Skyjo
subtitle: Swap your way to the lowest score. Clear columns of three.
description: Everyone has 12 face-down cards. On your turn, draw a card and swap it into your grid, or toss it and flip one of yours. Three matching cards in a column disappear. When someone reveals their whole grid, everyone else gets one last turn. The first to 100 points ends the game, and the lowest total wins.
